definition: to reserve every place so none is left
description: In an elegant restaurant in the evening, a bearded man in a black shirt stands at the glass door and spreads his hands apologetically toward a young couple: a woman with braids in a burgundy blouse and black skirt, and a man in a cream jumper. The couple turn and walk away past him while he presses his hands together. Every table is set with white cloths, candles, water carafes and glasses. Waiters in white shirts work near a stack of plates, and round paper lanterns hang from the dark wooden ceiling.

taps.phrase: to reach for the door handle
taps.target: the man in the cream jumper
